reference_translation: Tea has a history of 5,000 years. Legend has it that when Shen Nong was drinking boiled water, several wild tree leaves fell into the kettle, and the boiled water immediately gave off a pleasant fragrance. He took a few sips and found it very refreshing. Thus, tea was discovered. Since then, tea has become popular in China. Tea plantations are spread all over the country, and tea merchants have become wealthy. Expensive and elegant tea sets have become a symbol of status. Today, tea is not only a healthy drink but also an integral part of Chinese culture. More and more international tourists are getting to know Chinese culture while sipping tea.
